scope: Read-only inspection of pre-existing metadata and task-owned raw log bytes; no product imports, fixture/test/build execution, network/model/Git, or archive creation. Only this owned /tmp receipt/report is written.
countSource: Each pre-existing log has exactly one anchored Completed Bun shard line. Counts also agree with its anchored Bun pass/fail and Ran ... across 1 file summaries. code and signal are read from existing metadata, not inferred from raw log text.
hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 over Path.read_bytes() with no decoding, trimming, newline normalization, or recompression. UTF-8 decoding is used separately for summary parsing.

proofLimits: This is a durability/cross-consistency audit of prior result artifacts. It adds no tests or findings and does not revalidate any current product snapshot.
Metadata explicitly carries code=0 and signal=null; raw Completed and Bun summaries corroborate completion and counts. Log text alone is not an OS process exit-status receipt.

The original metadata/logs do not independently cryptographically bind every tested source/dependency/runtime/environment byte. No claim of whole-product correctness or latest-baseline equivalence follows.
No tar.gz has been created or inspected by this audit. A later archive must retain these exact member bytes and can be checked against this per-log receipt.
Current audit did not exercise products or original scripts. Existing historic execution provenance/guard scope remains the responsibility of the corresponding prior review receipts.
